user_intent: Enable PostHog session recording, then fix a batch of hero polish issues: physics pile jitter, scroll-to alignment with the nav, slow mobile background loading, meadow video centering, and (abandoned) an animated fake-cursor onboarding guide.
resolution: PostHog session recording shipped with maskAllInputs and recording disabled on localhost. Physics jitter was fixed with a snap-on-settle pattern in PhysicsTileStack (freeze position/angle in a ref once at rest, stop updating until re-popped) plus tighter damping; work-page scroll-to was aligned by correcting scroll-margin-top for the nav logo's actual 6px offset from --nav-inset; slow mobile backgrounds were fixed by preloading the active variant's meadow video/poster in warmVariant, and meadow is vertically centered only at the small-viewport-height breakpoint. A fake-cursor demo guide (HeroCursorGuide.tsx, heroDemoTarget.tsx, hero-cursor-guide.css) was built, iterated on, and then fully deleted at the user's request.
